name: Electric (EV)
description: Battery electric vehicles powered only by an electric motor and a rechargeable battery, with no combustion engine.

name: Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV)
description: Plug-in hybrid electric vehicles combining an electric motor with a combustion engine and a rechargeable battery.

name: Hybrid (HEV)
description: Non-plug-in hybrid electric vehicles combining a combustion engine with an electric motor that recharges during driving.

name: Petrol
description: Internal-combustion vehicles powered by a petrol (gasoline) engine.

name: Diesel
description: Internal-combustion vehicles powered by a diesel engine.
